model.description: Provider model id of the screen's judge. Empty as shipped: a screen without a judge is judged by the floor alone. Set at instantiation (`DISPLAY_JUDGE_MODEL`) or per override_params.

api_key.description: Provider API key. Deprecated, removed in 0.63.0: name a grant in credential_grant_id instead (#801).

credential_grant_id.description: GH #801: the grant this judge presents to get its provider credential SEALED from an access hive instead of carrying a key. It ships EMPTY, which is no grant at all; whoever grows the screen sets it through `override_params`, and the credential then arrives over the credential v-lane and is opened in RAM only. Immutable: a new grant is a new instance.

messages.description: Not required (GH #1061): the sealed credential box the access hive delivers on `in_sealed` carries `sealed` and nothing else, and a required key here would refuse it at delivery.

description.purpose: The screen's judge: a minimal model that re-judges the WHOLE screen on every content change and answers with one JSON verdict -- the bar (`focus`, 0..1), a weight per context, and per window an optional `hidden` or `relevance`. It is the master over focus (the guideline in this template's README); applications and the floor give hints.
description.use_when: When `compose.judge` is `on` and a model is set. Never on a tick, never on a write that changed nothing.
description.not_in_scope: No tools, no memory beyond what the root carries, no learning of preferences. A failed or late verdict changes nothing: the floor has already drawn.
